summary: Have fun learning with Super Wings! Educational Games for kids
description: Join the amazing experience of playing and learning at the same time with your favorite cartoon Super Wings, the perfect game for toddlers adventurers! Get ready for an exciting trip through different mini-games that will make kids have fun and develop different skills! In this Super Wings free game, kids will enjoy a variety of fun and educational activities. Find the different children's mini games on the world map and start playing! These are the different learning games of Super Wings in English: - Catch the Packages - Museum of painting - Fun race - Memory cards - Find objects - Museum Maze - Cookie store - Obstacle Maze - Puzzles In each game kids and babies develop different skills such as imagination, memory or visual acuity. It's time to have fun with amazing free Super Wings airplane educational games that help toddlers and infants active learning. Every Super Wings kids mini game is a unique challenge or puzzle for entertainment and teaching: - Catch the Packages: help Jett collect all the packages he needs. A great educational game for learning numbers and letters. - Museum of painting: in this fun painting game kids can let their imagination run wild and color their favorite Super Wings characters. - Fun race: who will be the first to reach the finish line in the car race in the desert? Children will have to accelerate hard and show their driving skills to win! - Memory cards: classic game of remembering the position of each card to match those with the same drawing. The little ones will be able to test their memory and improve it by matching the cards of the Super Wings characters: Jett, Sky, Paul and many more! - Find objects: It's time to search and find the objects hidden in the different scenarios of these cartoons. - Museum Maze: Can you solve the maze and find the exit? Pay attention and don't get lost along the way! - Cookie Shop: A perfect puzzle to learn to identify shapes. Drag the correct shapes into place to complete the puzzles. - Obstacle Maze: pay attention and move forward avoiding all the obstacles along the way. - Puzzle: move the puzzle pieces to complete the puzzle and discover the image of your favorite cartoon, the Super Wings airplanes. Enjoy an exciting adventure playing the fun games of your favorite cartoon Super Wings in English and totally free. FEATURES OF SUPER WINGS - EDUCATIONAL GAMES - Super Wings official App - Fun games for kids learning - Puzzles for kids and toddlers - Educational games to develop skills - Colorful graphics and attractive designs for children - Simple and intuitive interface ABOUT SUPER WINGS Super Wings is a playful children's series, very popular among kids and toddlers. Jett, Dizzy, Jerome and other airplane friends go on amazing adventures together as they learn the values of life delivering packages to children all over the world.
